description: Word limits per marketing-page slot, plus the banned-word and acronym checks that go with them. Marketing surfaces only: product UI keeps using data/components.json. Counts are whitespace-separated tokens that contain a letter or digit, so a hyphenated word like "in-house" counts as one. Run scripts/check-slots.mjs instead of counting by hand.

banned_terms.description: Puffery. Use a number, a place, or a fact instead. 'leading' is a warning, not a failure, because it is also a normal verb.
